definitions.explanation: The outer husks of buckwheat seeds, separated from the grain during milling. Traditionally used in Japan as a pillow filling because they are light, firm, and breathable.

examples.japanese: {蕎麦殻|そばがら}の{枕|まくら}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I use a buckwheat hull pillow.

examples.japanese: {蕎麦殻|そばがら}は{通気性|つうきせい}がよい。
{祖母|そぼ}は{昔|むかし}ながらの{蕎麦殻|そばがら}{枕|まくら}を{愛用|あいよう}している。
examples.english: My grandmother is fond of the traditional buckwheat hull pillow.

notes:
Compound of {蕎麦|そば} (buckwheat) + {殻|がら} (husk, shell), with kara shifting to gara through rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蕎麦殻|そばがら}の{枕|まくら}: buckwheat hull pillow
- {蕎麦殻|そばがら}を{詰|つ}める: to fill with buckwheat hulls
- {蕎麦殻|そばがら}{枕|まくら}: buckwheat hull pillow (compound form)

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
The そばがら pillow is one of the oldest pillow fillings in Japan. It conforms to the shape of the head, stays cool in summer, and rustles softly when the user shifts. People with buckwheat allergies should avoid it.
